items.name: The operator starts a run, and it performs the cycle's effects up to the gate's verdict
items.rule: A run starts once, one at a time, on a commit of the project repository, with its five contexts responding
items.evidence: s/s1: start-run responded with R-1 awaiting-verdicts; effects 1-9 stamp,pin,checklist,self-check,fence,regenerate,install,self-check,gate all recorded; gate events [regeneration-cycle/gate-attempt-passed].

items.name: A run identity is started once
items.rule: A run starts once, one at a time, on a commit of the project repository, with its five contexts responding
items.evidence: s/fence: R-1 C-1 failed at fence (fence-refused); start R-1 of C-2 refused run-already-started; run-progress lists R-1 once, cycle C-1.

items.name: A second run is refused while the first awaits its verdicts
items.rule: A run starts once, one at a time, on a commit of the project repository, with its five contexts responding
items.evidence: s/s1: with R-1 awaiting, start R-2 C-2 refused run-in-progress; run-progress lists only R-1, still awaiting-verdicts.

items.name: A cycle is run once
items.rule: A run starts once, one at a time, on a commit of the project repository, with its five contexts responding
items.evidence: s/s1: after R-1 of C-1 passed, start R-2 of C-1 refused cycle-already-run; no R-2 in run-progress.

items.name: A run of something that is not a commit of the project repository is refused
items.rule: A run starts once, one at a time, on a commit of the project repository, with its five contexts responding
items.evidence: s/t005: deadbeef... refused not-a-commit; run-progress R-1 null, runs []; builder never launched (no launch log).

items.name: A run whose context does not respond on its seam is refused
items.rule: A run starts once, one at a time, on a commit of the project repository, with its five contexts responding
items.evidence: s/t006: measurement entrypoint exits at once -> refused contexts-not-responding, data.contexts [measurement]; R-1 null. Variation t006b (grader-lifecycle unnamed + measurement exiting) names both.

items.name: Each handoff is handed in, unchanged and once, to every consumer, in its producer's order
items.rule: The runner stamps, pins and derives the checklist, and relays every handoff from its producer's store
items.evidence: s/s1: relayed handoffs begin scenario-stamped pos1,pos2 -> measurement, then source-cut-pinned pos1 -> measurement and -> regeneration-cycle; gate-attempt-passed pos1 -> measurement once; all accepted.

items.name: A checklist Measurement refuses halts the run with Measurement's refusal
items.rule: The runner stamps, pins and derives the checklist, and relays every handoff from its producer's store
items.evidence: s/t008: plan with no scenario: checklist effect refused empty-checklist (measurement); run halted at checklist, refused-before-the-cycle; effects stamp,pin,checklist only.

items.name: A plan whose item identities a fresh stamp does not give back halts the run before the cycle
items.rule: The runner stamps, pins and derives the checklist, and relays every handoff from its producer's store
items.evidence: s/t009: extra unstamped scenario: stamp recorded (3 scenario-stamped events); halted at stamp, refused-before-the-cycle, detail names [01-001 01-002 01-003] vs plan's [01-001 01-002]; no pin/checklist effect.

items.name: A failing self-check fails the cycle at the fence, and the run with it
items.rule: No clean room is built over a failed harness self-check
items.evidence: s/t010: run failed; cycle failed at fence, reason harness-self-check-failed, detail 'golden checklist differs'; last effect self-check (pos 4), no fence/regenerate effect.

items.name: A check the self-check skips is recorded as a listed skip
items.rule: No clean room is built over a failed harness self-check
items.evidence: s/t011: first self-check recorded harness-self-check-passed with skipped-checks ["bb-tools"]; detail 'skipped checks: bb-tools'.

items.name: A fenced path that matches nothing fails the cycle at the fence
items.rule: The fence builds the clean room of the cut and proves it, as legacy fence.sh does
items.evidence: s/fence: fence effect refused fenced-path-matched-nothing (regeneration-cycle); next effect fail-cycle recorded; R-1 failed at fence for fence-refused; no builder launch logged.

items.name: The fresh builder sees the clean room of one commit with no fenced path
items.rule: The fence builds the clean room of the cut and proves it, as legacy fence.sh does
items.evidence: s/s1 builder log: room held docs/plan/01-a/spec.feature, harness/config.sh, empty impl/; git rev-list --all count 1, one root; no impl or harness/cycles path in tree or rev-list --objects --all.

items.name: Each regenerate launches one builder and waits for it
items.rule: A regenerate launches one fresh builder and records what it left in its candidate scope
items.evidence: s/t014: red then green: builder launched twice (regenerate attempt 1, repair attempt 2); launch 2 started 1794139854.75 after launch 1 ended 1794139853.66; run awaits verdicts.

items.name: A builder that exits non-zero but leaves a candidate is gated
items.rule: A regenerate launches one fresh builder and records what it left in its candidate scope
items.evidence: s/t015: builder exited 1 leaving green candidate; regenerate effect recorded with candidate sha256:95d63f41..., install same; R-1 awaits verdicts. (First try under heavy parallel load refused contexts-not-responding; rerun at lower load.)

items.name: A builder that leaves nothing fails the cycle at regenerate
items.rule: A regenerate launches one fresh builder and records what it left in its candidate scope
items.evidence: s/t016: empty scope: no regenerate effect; fail-cycle recorded; R-1 failed at regenerate for candidate-not-regenerated.

items.name: A builder that outlives the regenerate timeout is stopped and the cycle fails for its budget
items.rule: A regenerate launches one fresh builder and records what it left in its candidate scope
items.evidence: s/t017: regenerate timeout 2s, builder sleeps 30: builder pid dead when start-run responded and never woke after 32s; R-1 failed at regenerate for budget.

items.name: Something answering on the port is a gate refusal, and three in a row fail the cycle
items.rule: The gate grades a copy of the candidate on the host, in legacy verify.sh's order
items.evidence: s/t018 (and s/t018-run1, reproduced): port held by grader; gate attempt 1 refused seam-answered-before-boot once, gate-refusal recorded, then the re-self-check was refused self-check-already-recorded by regeneration-cycle and the run HALTED (effect-could-not-run) at effect 11. Not three refusals, cycle not failed for infrastructure (status halted). Launch entrypoint never started (that part held).

items.name: A red suite fails the attempt before the candidate is booted
items.rule: The gate grades a copy of the candidate on the host, in legacy verify.sh's order
items.evidence: s/t019: limit 1, red suite: gate attempt 1 gate-attempt-failed reason suite-red; start.sh never ran (no start-ran.log); failed at gate gate-attempts-exhausted.

items.name: A candidate with no launch entrypoint fails the attempt for a missing contract
items.rule: The gate grades a copy of the candidate on the host, in legacy verify.sh's order
items.evidence: s/t020: no start.sh, limit 1: gate-attempt-failed reason contract-missing.

items.name: A served page without the marker fails the attempt for its identity
items.rule: The gate grades a copy of the candidate on the host, in legacy verify.sh's order
items.evidence: s/t021: page without sauna, limit 1: gate-attempt-failed reason identity-probe-failed ('page at http://127.0.0.1:23121 does not carry "sauna"').

items.name: What a builder writes after it ended does not reach the gate
items.rule: The gate grades a copy of the candidate on the host, in legacy verify.sh's order
items.evidence: s/t022: builder kept writing impl/RED (suite fails if present) after exit; RED present in builder room, absent in gate-1; gate attempt 1 passed; install digest == regenerate digest sha256:11c3ccc7...

items.name: A repair builder sees the previous candidate and the gate evidence, read-only
items.rule: A failed gate attempt is repaired by a fresh builder that sees only the previous candidate and the gate's evidence
items.evidence: s/t014: repair effect attempt 2 recorded (verification-repair), detail mounted read-only .repair/previous-candidate and .repair/gate-evidence/attempt-1; launch 2 saw clean room (docs, harness), previous candidate and attempt-1 evidence (gate.log, suite.log), both not writable (PermissionError).

items.name: Three failed attempts fail the cycle, and no fourth builder is launched
items.rule: A failed gate attempt is repaired by a fresh builder that sees only the previous candidate and the gate's evidence
items.evidence: s/t024: always red: builder launched 3 times; R-1 failed at gate for gate-attempts-exhausted.

items.name: Verdicts handed in are filed as given, and the run passes as its cycle passes
items.rule: The verdicts of the gated candidate are handed in, filed as given, and the run ends as its cycle ends
items.evidence: s/s1: hand-in v1 (01-001 pass 'booked', 01-002 fail 'judged by the main session') under r-1: file-verdicts and file-score recorded; measurement-filed passes 1 total 2 with those evidences; R-1 passed, cycle passed.

items.name: An item the verdicts file does not name is Measurement's to record as unreached
items.rule: The verdicts of the gated candidate are handed in, filed as given, and the run ends as its cycle ends
items.evidence: s/s2: verdicts with only 01-001: measurement-filed shows 01-002 fail reason unreached; passes 1 of 2; R-1 passed.

items.name: Verdicts for a run that does not exist are refused
items.rule: The verdicts of the gated candidate are handed in, filed as given, and the run ends as its cycle ends
items.evidence: s/s1: hand-in for R-9 refused no-run; run-progress R-9 null.

items.name: Verdicts for a run whose gate never passed are refused
items.rule: The verdicts of the gated candidate are handed in, filed as given, and the run ends as its cycle ends
items.evidence: s/t024: after gate-attempts-exhausted, hand-in refused gate-not-passed; still failed, 17 effects, no file-verdicts.

items.name: A second verdicts file is refused, and no builder follows the verdicts
items.rule: The verdicts of the gated candidate are handed in, filed as given, and the run ends as its cycle ends
items.evidence: s/t032: after score-stage-failed, second hand-in refused verdicts-already-handed-in; effects after verdicts only file-verdicts, fail-score-stage; builder launched once in total.

items.name: Verdicts under a grader digest the run did not approve are refused

items.name: A verdicts file that is blank is refused, and nothing is filed
items.rule: The verdicts of the gated candidate are handed in, filed as given, and the run ends as its cycle ends
items.evidence: s/s2: empty file and whitespace-only file both refused verdicts-not-readable; R-1 still awaiting, no file-verdicts effect (later hand-in filed normally).

items.name: Verdicts Measurement refuses fail the score stage, and the run fails with its cycle
items.rule: The verdicts of the gated candidate are handed in, filed as given, and the run ends as its cycle ends
items.evidence: s/t032: verdicts 01-001 + 09-001: file-verdicts refused unknown-item (measurement); fail-score-stage recorded; R-1 failed at score for score-stage-failed; no builder launch after verdicts.

items.name: A context that stops answering halts the run, and nothing is recorded for that effect
items.rule: A run that cannot perform an effect halts, loudly, and a run that ended stays as it ended
items.evidence: s/t033: measurement wrapper exits on derive-checklist: halted at checklist, context-did-not-respond; effects only stamp, pin (no checklist result).

items.name: A run that ended stays as it ended
items.rule: A run that cannot perform an effect halts, loudly, and a run that ended stays as it ended
items.evidence: s/fence: R-1 failed at fence, R-2 halted at checklist; re-read 22s and 5.5s after the starts responded: statuses unchanged, effect-results and relayed-handoffs identical.

items.name: Reading a run's progress changes nothing
items.rule: A run that cannot perform an effect halts, loudly, and a run that ended stays as it ended
items.evidence: s/s1: two run-progress reads of awaiting R-1 have identical results; status awaiting-verdicts; runs-to-advance [].

items.name: A stdio candidate whose suite, identity probe and store check pass passes the gate
items.rule: A stdio candidate is gated as harness/v2/gate.sh gates it: its suite, its identity probe, then the store the probe's candidate wrote
items.evidence: s/t039: stdio, probe prints 'answered as the context' exit 0, store check 0: gate-attempt-passed with boot-budget-seconds 30, boot-polls 1, answered-on-poll 1, identity-probe-result 'answered as the context'; no gate-refusal; awaits verdicts.

items.name: The identity probe is handed the gate room's launch entrypoint, the boot budget and the gate's store, and the store check reads that store
items.rule: A stdio candidate is gated as harness/v2/gate.sh gates it: its suite, its identity probe, then the store the probe's candidate wrote
items.evidence: s/t039 & s/t039b: probe argv [<runs>/R-1/gate-1/impl/start.sh, 30]; GATE_STORE=<runs>/R-1/evidence/attempt-1/events.sqlite (under runs dir, outside gate-1); no LOYLY_* in probe env; store check argv [same path]. With unrelated GATE_STORE=/tmp/unrelated-outer-gate/events.sqlite exported into the runner (t039b; confirmed in builder env) probe still got the gate's own store, store check saw no GATE_STORE/LOYLY_*.

items.name: A red stdio suite fails the attempt before the identity probe, and the suite is handed no store

items.evidence: s/t041 & s/t041b: limit 1, red stdio suite: gate-attempt-failed suite-red; suite env held no GATE_STORE and no LOYLY_* (also with inherited GATE_STORE exported into the runner, t041b); no probe-run or storecheck-run record.

items.name: An identity probe that fails fails the attempt for its identity, and the store is not checked
